instruction: Enable VS Code to automatically create a Git commit with a descriptive message every time I save a file, without installing any extensions.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not have built-in functionality to automatically create Git commits on file save, nor can it generate descriptive commit messages automatically. This would require extensions or external automation scripts.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible - VS Code has no built-in auto-commit-on-save functionality
The 'infeasible' evaluator function appropriately handles tasks that cannot be completed as stated
No verification logic is needed since the task requirements are impossible to fulfill without extensions
Metadata explanation accurately describes why the task is infeasible
